data.long_meaning: Aaima (أئمة) is the Arabic plural a'immah of imām, meaning 'leaders, guides, models to be followed'. It shares the root ʾ-m-m with imām and ummah (community).
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to leadership and guidance; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaima total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aaima mean?
What is the origin of the name Aaima?
What language does the name Aaima come from?
faq.a: Aaima is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aaima a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaima is used as a unisex name.

faq.q: How is Aaima written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aaima is written أئمة in Arabic and ائمہ in Urdu, and आइमा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aaima?
faq.a: The root of Aaima is أ-م-م (ʾ-m-m).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aaima?
Does Aaima appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; a'immah is the plural of imām, a term used in Islamic usage.
Aaima is the plural of imām, meaning 'leaders, guides, models to be followed'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aaima?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaima total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aaima?
faq.a: Aaima appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aima, Aimmah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aaima?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aaima include Aamil, Aameen.
Yes. A'immah is the plural of the singular imām; both come from the root ʾ-m-m.

faq.q: Where is the name Aaima used today?
faq.a: Aaima is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
